strings.settings_screens_terms_sec1_body: By downloading, installing, or using TravelTrackerCompanion (\"the App,\" \"we,\" \"us,\" \"our\"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Conditions (\"Terms\"). If you do not agree, do not use the App.
strings.settings_screens_terms_sec2_body: TravelTrackerCompanion is a personal travel-tracking application that lets you log trips, track budgets and packing checklists, store trip-related documents in an encrypted local vault, and view travel statistics including a world map of places you\'ve visited. The App stores your data locally on your device — see the Privacy Policy for full detail on data storage and your rights.
strings.settings_screens_terms_sec3_body: You must meet the minimum age required by your jurisdiction and the App\'s store age rating to use the App. By using the App, you represent that you meet this requirement.
strings.settings_screens_terms_sec4_body: The App does not require or offer user accounts, sign-up, or login. All app data is associated with your device, not with an account we manage. If you uninstall the App or switch devices without first backing up or exporting your data, your trip data cannot be recovered by us, because we do not hold a copy of it.
strings.settings_screens_terms_sec5_body: The App offers a Free tier with usage limits and a paid Premium tier (subscription or one-time Lifetime purchase) that removes these limits and unlocks additional features. Current limits are viewable in the App\'s Settings/Upgrade screen. Subscriptions are billed through the Apple App Store or Google Play Store, at the price and interval displayed at the time of purchase, and automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, managed entirely through your Apple ID or Google Play account settings. We do not have the ability to process, view, or refund payments directly — all billing management and refund requests go through Apple/Google\'s own systems. The App may offer a free trial period; if you do not cancel before the trial ends, you will be automatically charged for the subscription you selected. We may, from time to time, offer temporary promotional unlocks of Premium features or temporary increases to Free-tier limits, at our discretion, for a limited time; content created while a temporary limit increase is active will not be deleted or removed when the promotion ends. All purchases are subject to Apple\'s or Google\'s respective refund policies; we do not independently grant refunds outside of those platforms\' processes.
strings.settings_screens_terms_sec6_body: You retain all ownership rights to the trip data, photos, notes, and documents you create or upload within the App (\"Your Content\"). We do not claim any ownership over Your Content. Your Content is stored locally on your device and we do not have routine access to it, except: if you use the trip-sharing feature, the specific trip you choose to share is transmitted to enable that sharing. You are solely responsible for Your Content, including its accuracy and legality, and for the security of your own device and device-unlock credentials — the Document Vault applies platform-native encryption, but it is not a substitute for keeping your device itself physically secure, and we are not liable for loss or exposure of Vault contents resulting from loss, theft, or compromise of your physical device or your device passcode/biometric credentials.
strings.settings_screens_terms_sec7_body: You agree not to: use the App for any illegal purpose or in violation of any applicable law; attempt to reverse-engineer, decompile, or extract the source code of the App, except to the extent applicable law expressly permits this despite this restriction; attempt to circumvent, disable, or interfere with the App\'s Premium-feature entitlement checks or usage quotas; use the App\'s trip-sharing feature to distribute content that violates a third party\'s rights or privacy; or interfere with or disrupt the App\'s integration with third-party services (weather, flight, currency data providers, or app store billing infrastructure).
strings.settings_screens_terms_sec8_body: The App displays weather, flight status, and currency conversion information sourced from third-party services. We do not control, and cannot guarantee the accuracy of, this third-party data. Flight status information shown in the App is provided for general informational convenience only and must not be relied upon for time-critical travel decisions (e.g., whether you will make a connecting flight) — always verify flight status directly with your airline or at the airport. We disclaim all liability for any loss, missed connection, or expense arising from reliance on in-app flight status information. Currency conversion rates and budget totals shown in the App are provided for personal tracking convenience only and should not be relied upon for financial, tax, or accounting purposes.
strings.settings_screens_terms_sec9_body: Because the App stores data locally on your device with no automatic cloud backup by default, you are solely responsible for backing up or exporting your data. We are not liable for loss of Your Content resulting from device loss, damage, factory reset, app uninstallation, or operating system issues.

strings.settings_screens_privacy_sec1_body: This Privacy Policy explains how TravelTrackerCompanion (\"the App,\" \"we,\" \"us,\" \"our\") handles information when you use our mobile application on Android and iOS. The short version, stated plainly: this app stores your trip data — trips, photos, budgets, checklists, documents — locally on your own device. We do not operate a server that stores your personal trip content, and we do not have user accounts. This means we generally cannot see, access, or hand over your trip data even if asked to, because we don\'t have it — it never leaves your device except through features you explicitly choose to use, such as sharing a specific trip via a link, or creating an encrypted backup file. The remainder of this policy explains the specific, narrower set of data that does involve us or third-party services, and why.
strings.settings_screens_privacy_sec2_body: Trip data (destination, dates, notes, transportation mode, budget/expense entries, checklist items) is stored locally on your device in an encrypted local database. We do not receive a copy of this data on any server we operate, unless you use the trip-sharing feature (§2.4) — encrypted backups (§4.4) are also never sent to us. Photos — your profile photo, trip cover photos, and photos attached to individual trips — are stored locally on your device, added only with your explicit permission at the time you choose to add a photo. Document Vault photos and files are additionally encrypted at rest using your device\'s platform-native encryption. Profile information (display name, home city/country) is optional and used only to pre-fill your departure city when logging a new trip.
strings.settings_screens_privacy_sec3_body: If you subscribe to Premium or make a one-time purchase, the transaction itself is processed entirely by Apple (App Store) or Google (Play Store) — we do not see or store your payment card details at any point. We receive and store only your subscription tier (Free/Premium/Lifetime), purchase/renewal dates, and a platform-issued purchase identifier, used solely to unlock Premium features on your device and to validate your entitlement.
strings.settings_screens_privacy_sec4_body: Documents you choose to store in the in-app Document Vault (e.g., boarding passes, booking confirmations, ID scans) are encrypted at rest on your device using platform-native encryption. We do not have access to your Vault contents — they are encrypted with a key tied to your device and, where the platform supports it, your biometric or device authentication.
strings.settings_screens_privacy_sec5_body: If you choose to generate a shareable link for a specific trip, that trip\'s data is encoded directly into the link itself and transmitted to enable the person you share it with to view or import it - there is no server in between. Because the data travels inside the link, anyone who already has it can continue to view or import it even after you close the share dialog: there is no way to revoke or expire access to a link once it has been shared.
strings.settings_screens_privacy_sec6_body: Where crash reporting is enabled, we may collect device model, OS version, app version, and diagnostic information about crashes or errors, including stack traces, to help us identify and fix bugs. This information does not include your trip content, photos, or documents.
strings.settings_screens_privacy_sec7_body: We may collect limited, aggregated usage analytics, such as feature usage and session length, to help us understand how the app is used and to improve it. This does not include your trip content, photos, or documents.
strings.settings_screens_privacy_sec8_body: We do not collect your device\'s GPS or precise location. Trip destinations (city, country) are entered by you as text or selected from an autocomplete list — the App does not request or use location permissions for trip logging.
strings.settings_screens_privacy_sec9_body: On Android, we use Firebase Crashlytics to collect crash data to help us identify and fix bugs. When crash reporting is enabled (the default for new installs), we collect crash logs, stack traces, device model, OS version, and app version. This information does not include your trip content, photos, or documents. You can disable crash reporting at any time in Settings — no crash data will be collected or sent while disabled. Users can disable crash reporting in the Privacy Settings section of the app.
